# CryptoPriceTicker.com

> Free, ad-free live cryptocurrency prices streamed directly from the public market-data feeds of Coinbase, Binance and Kraken. No account needed. Covers 110+ coins with per-coin pages (performance, 52-week range, monthly price history, per-exchange prices and spread) and sector overviews.

## Main pages
- [Live crypto prices](https://cryptopriceticker.com/): live table of 110+ coins by market cap, sector filters, biggest movers
- [About & data methodology](https://cryptopriceticker.com/about/): data sources and how market cap, volume, depth and performance are calculated
- [Market heatmap](https://cryptopriceticker.com/heatmap/): every coin sized by market cap and coloured by 24-hour change
- [Crypto converter](https://cryptopriceticker.com/convert/): any coin to any coin or 20 fiat currencies at live prices
- [Free website widget](https://cryptopriceticker.com/widgets/): embeddable live crypto ticker (iframe), three layouts, six themes
- [Brand kit](https://cryptopriceticker.com/brand/): logos, colours and banners for press and partners
- [Accessibility statement](https://cryptopriceticker.com/accessibility/): WCAG 2.1 AA / EN 301 549 status and how to report a barrier
- [Trust and verification](https://cryptopriceticker.com/trust/): public source code on GitHub (usaflees/cpt), hosted on Cloudflare Pages, no accounts, payments or wallet connections; domain registered 22 October 2026

## Coin pages
Every coin has a page at `https://cryptopriceticker.com/coin/<ticker>/` (lowercase), for example [Bitcoin](https://cryptopriceticker.com/coin/btc/) and [Ethereum](https://cryptopriceticker.com/coin/eth/). The full list is in the [sitemap](https://cryptopriceticker.com/sitemap.xml).

## Notes
- Prices on the pages update live in the browser; the static HTML contains weekly snapshots with their dates.
- Each coin page states its performance figures (7-day to 1-year change, 52-week range, volatility, monthly closes) with the exchange and date of the latest daily close.
- Citing a figure: please link the coin page and give the "as of" date shown on it.
- Not financial advice.
